trace.msg: Let's look at this puzzle carefully. I'll only move when I can explain why.
I can't rule out right or left yet, so I'll make an educated guess: right.
Cell (1,6) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now: it goes up.

Contradiction! Every way forward fails: going left, the next 6 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (5,5); going down, every way of continuing runs into a dead end within a few moves. So my guess (right from number 1) was wrong, so the line must go left.
I can't rule out up, left or down yet, so I'll make an educated guess: up.

Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes right.
Going left would force the line onto number 5 before its turn. So the line goes down.

Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes left.
Going up, the next 3 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (6,3). So the line goes left.
Going up leaves no safe move afterwards. So the line goes left.
Number 4 is only reachable this way.
The line must go right: up is number 6, which comes later; left is number 9, which comes later.

Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes down.

Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes down.
Every cell is covered and the numbers are in order. Case closed!
